revisions.title: Large CSV export — stops at the 60 s gateway timeout
revisions.summary: Exports of very large reports fail at the gateway's 60-second limit.
revisions.body:
# Problem or question
CSV export of large reports stops after 60 seconds.

# Observations and evidence
- Reproduced with a 200,000-row report on a test space.
- The gateway closes the connection at 60 s.

# Impact and risk
Users with large reports cannot export them.

# Resolution conditions
A 200,000-row export completes or streams.
